translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Be bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔsu
kɔ̃su
Bɑ be bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su bɔnu kuɑ wuu wuukɑ. Koren bweseru sɔɔ, Mɛselemiɑ, Koren bii, Asɑfun debubuwɑ bɑ gɔsɑ.
Bibu nɔɔbɑ yiruwɑ u mɑrɑ. Wee nge mɛ bɑ kɑ swĩinɛ. Sɑkɑri kɑ Yediɛli kɑ Sebɑdiɑ kɑ Yɑtiniɛli,
kɑ Elɑmu kɑ Yokɑnɑni kɑ sere Elionɑi.
Bɑ mɑɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu gɔsɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn domɑru kuɑ, u bibu nɔɔbɑ itɑ mɑrɑ. Wee nge mɛ bɑ kɑ swĩinɛ. Semɑyɑ kɑ Yosɑbɑdi kɑ Yoɑsi kɑ Sɑkɑɑ kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli,
kɑ Amiɛli kɑ Isɑkɑri kɑ sere Pɛlitɑi.
Semɑyɑ, Obɛdi Edɔmun bii gbiikoo u bibu mɑrɑ be bɑ kuɑ dɑmgibu, begibun suunu sɔɔ. Domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔrugɔbɑ.
Bii berɑ, Otini kɑ Refɑɛli kɑ Obɛdi kɑ Ɛlisɑbɑdi kɑ sere ben wɔnɔbu yiru beni, Elihu kɑ Semɑyɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wɔrugɔbɑ.
Tɔn be kpurowɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Obɛdi Edɔmun bibun bweseru. Be kɑ ben bibu kɑ ben dusibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔrugɔbɑ mɑ bɑ hɑniɑ mɔ sɔmburu sɔɔ. Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɑtɑ kɑ yiru.
Mɛselemiɑn bibu kɑ win wɔnɔbu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔrugɔbɑ.

Mɛrɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, Hosɑwɑ bɑ gɔsɑ. Bibu nnɛwɑ u mɑrɑ. Berɑ Simiri kɑ Hilikiyɑ kɑ Tebɑliɑ kɑ Sɑkɑri. Mɑ u Simuri kuɑ ben wirugii bɑɑ mɛ n ǹ wi u sɑ̃ɑ bii gbiikoo. Hosɑn bibu kɑ win wɔnɔbu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɔkurɑ itɑ.
Kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobun wuu ni, kɑ nin wirugibu kɑ ben mɛro bisibu, berɑ bɑ ko n dɑ kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Bɑ kɔnnɔsu bɔnu kuɑwɑ kɑ tɛtɛ, yɛnu kɑ yɛnu, bibu kɑ bukurobu, bɑɑwure u n kɑ yɛ̃ mi u koo kɔ̃su.
Ye bɑ tɛtɛ tobɑ, sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑrɑ Selemiɑ u wɑ. Mɑ win bii Sɑkɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ bwisi kɛ̃ɔ u mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑ tɛtɛ di.
Obɛdi Edɔmuwɑ u sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrugiɑ tɛtɛ di. Mɑ win bii u mɑɑ yɛnusu tɛtɛ di mi bɑ rɑ dĩɑnu bere.
Supimu kɑ Hosɑwɑ bɑ kɔnnɔ ge gɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru giɑ tɛtɛ di, kɑ ge bɑ mɔ̀ Sɑlekɛti, gɑ mɛɛrɑ swɑɑɔ ye yɑ dɔɔ gunguru giɑ. Kɔ̃so be, bɑ mɛɛrinɛwɑ.

Tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere Lefibɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ, kpɑ tɔmbu nnɛ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm geu giɑ, kpɑ nnɛ bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ kpɑ nnɛ bɑ n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ diɑɔ mi bɑ rɑ dĩɑnu bere. Adɑmɑ bɑ diɑgii be bɔnu sɑ̃ɑwɑ wuunu yiru, wuu teerɔ tɔmbu yiru.
Sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru giɑ, diɑ ye bɑ gɔri gɔri sɔɔ, tɔmbu yiru, swɑɑn berɑ giɑ, mɑɑ tɔmbu yiru.
Kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobun wuu ni bɑ kuɑ Kore kɑ Mɛrɑrin bwese kɛri sɔɔ, niyɑ mi.
Sɔmɑ ye bɑ Lefi gɑbu wɛ̃
Lefibɑ sɔɔ, Akiyɑwɑ u rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɑrumɑni bere kɑ sere mɑɑ kɛ̃ɛ ni bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑwɑ.
Gɛɛsɔnin bweseru sɔɔ, Lɑdɑnin bibun bweserɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robu. Wee nge mɛ bɑ kɑ swĩinɛ.
Yeyɛli kɑ win bibu Setɑmu kɑ win wɔnɔ Yoɛli berɑ bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun ɑrumɑni bere.
Amurɑmun bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Yisehɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Heboronin bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Usiɛlin bweseru sɔɔ,
Sebuɛli, Gɛɛsɔmun bii, Mɔwisin debubuwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ ɑrumɑnin berobun wirugii.
Win bweseru sɔɔrɑ Ɛliesɛɛ, Gɛɛsɔmun wɔnɔn bibun bweserɑ wɑ̃ɑ. Rehɑbiɑ, Ɛliesɛɛn bii u Esɑi mɑrɑ. Mɑ Esɑi u Yorɑmu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yorɑmu u Sikiri mɑrɑ. Mɑ Sikiri u Selomiti mɑrɑ.
Arumɑni ye sinɑ boko Dɑfidi kɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robu kɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔm nɔrɔm kɑ wunɔm wunɔm wirugibu kɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑwɑ, yerɑ Selomiti kɑ wigibu bɑ kɔ̃su.
N deemɑ ɑrumɑni ye bɑ tɑbu di, yen sukumɑ bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑwɑ bu kɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yeru sɔmɛ.
Arumɑni ye Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Sɑmuɛli kɑ Sɔɔlu, Kisin bii kɑ Abinɛɛ, Nɛrin bii kɑ Yoɑbu, Seruyɑn bii, bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑwɑ, Selomiti kɑ wigii berɑ bɑ mɑɑ ye kpuro beruɑ.
Kenɑniɑ kɑ win bibu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yisehɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, berɑ bɑ rɑ tɔmbun wunɑnɔsu kɑ siribu ko Isirelin temɔ.

Hɑsɑbiɑ kɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (1.700) gɑbu be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wɔrugɔbɑ Yisehɑrin bweseru sɔɔ, berɑ bɑ Isirelibɑn tem kpɑre mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru giɑ. Berɑ bɑ rɑ mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu ko kɑ mɑɑ sinɑ bokogiru.
Yeriyɑwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ wirugii Heboronin bweseru sɔɔ. Dɑfidin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ weeruse sɔɔrɑ bɑ bwese ten tɔ̃kɑn kɑso kuɑ. Mɑ bɑ wɔrugɔbɑ wɑ be sɔɔ Yɑsɛɛɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ.

Yeriɑn mɛro bisi be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔrugɔbɑ. Be kpuro mɑɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robɑ. Ben geerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (2.700). Berɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu kɑ mɑɑ sinɑ bokogiru nɔmu bɛriɑ berɑ mi Rubɛnibɑ kɑ Gɑdigibu kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukumgibɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru giɑ.
